name: What are common signs that my home needs plumbing maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my home needs plumbing maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your home could benefit from plumbing maintenance. These include recurring clogs, slow drains, a sudden drop in water pressure, unusual noises coming from pipes or the water heater, and discolored water. Even subtle indicators like a slight increase in your water bill without a change in usage can suggest a hidden leak. Addressing these early can prevent more severe and expensive plumbing failures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include recurring clogs, slow drains, low water pressure, unusual pipe noises, and unexplained high water bills.
